items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: There's a boy just come over from Paris, come over to see me. He's writing a book on that.

ctx.x: That's the same way in New York. I got kids around there that not only write books and have, oh, when they want to find out anything I can ask them. They have all of the data and they got so many books of all the bands of all the country. Not in New Orleans, but all over the country, you know. That's the one that got me those English records. I didn't know they were existing. Well, you know there's a second one.
Yeah, I got two of them. There's a boy just come over from Paris, come over to see me. He's writing a book on that.
